body.name: \(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{adm}}\)
body.construction: Let \(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{adm}}\) be the certified members of \(\mathfrak X_{\mathrm{adm}}\) not weakly dominated with one strict inequality in \((\underline\Gamma_{\mathcal T},\underline\kappa_{\mathcal T},\underline\Lambda_{\mathcal T},\underline\mu_{\mathcal T},-N_{\mathrm{req}},-w_{\mathrm{cert}},-\mathfrak B(\Xi))\).
